schools.name: Iron Hall
schools.description: A yard of posts, sand, and ringing steel. Warriors learn to stand and strike.

schools.name: Greenwatch
schools.description: A timber lodge at the treeline. Rangers track, shoot, and read the wild.

schools.name: Lantern Archive
schools.description: Shelves, chalk, and quiet light. Mages study pattern and will.

schools.name: Quiet Ledger
schools.description: A back-room circle of ledgers and locked boxes. Rogues trade in silence and timing.
